title: Rojavanam
desc: Muthu, an employee at an orphanage, falls in love with the daughter of the owner, Roja. However, things become complicated when it is revealed that she is to be married to someone else.

title: Monisha En Monalisa
desc: Rahul falls madly in love with Monisha, a pop singer who hates the idea of love. Though she resists his advances at first, fate plays a cruel game on them when she finally agrees to meet him.

title: Kanave Kalaiyathe
desc: Anand is distraught after the woman he loves dies in a blast. However, fate intervenes when he encounters her lookalike, leading to new complications in his life.

title: Thirunelveli
desc: Thulasi, a highly respected man in the village, is known for his truthfulness in all circumstances. But the real testing time arrives when his good trait brings a lot of trouble to the family.

title: Thenavattu
desc: Kottai supplies tools to a local gangster. When the goon's son Santhosh misbehaves with his girlfriend, Kottai loses his temper and beats him up, unaware of the miscreant's identity.
